B09ZY917TZ.title: Aqara Smart Curtain Motor E1 Track Version, 1 Pack
bullets: 【Works with Any Decor】NOTE: An Aqara Zigbee 3.0 Hub is required and sold separately. Easily mount the Curtain Motor E1 onto your existing curtain track or rod without any additional tools, it will be hidden behind the curtain, and you won’t need to worry about changing the decoration style of your home. (*NOTE: Track Version only supports U- and I-Rails. I-rail bottom width ≥ 0.4 inch, U-rail bottom slotting width ≤ 0.3 inch. U-rail gliders without wheels are not supported.)

【Multiple Control Methods】 After setting the guidance in the Aqara Home app, you will be able to control your curtains when you are away from home, or by voice commands with Siri, Alexa, or Google Assistant. Additionally, the built-in light sensor allows the Curtain Driver E1 to be controlled automatically based on the actual brightness. If it's too bright outside, the curtains will close by themselves.

【Smart Home Automations】The Aqara Curtain Motor E1 can help you to enjoy automated control of your existing curtains based on weather, time, lighting conditions or other Aqara devices triggered. You will be able to set a timer to customize a sleep-wake routine that perfectly fits your personal schedule. Automations via HomeKit, Alexa, Google Home and IFTTT are supported.

【Powerful Motor】Thanks to its powerful motor, the maximum load of the Curtain Motor E1 can reach up to 26.4 pounds. You can choose between one or two motors per window. In the case of installing two, they will be able to be grouped together so that you can open the curtains simultaneously.

【Long Battery Life】A huge 6400 mAh rechargeable battery may last for up to a year without charging. (The calculated battery life refers to opening and closing a curtain on a 5 ft track (i.e., 2 curtain drivers per window) once a day, and it also depends on friction, curtain weight and type.) Moreover, the device can be charged via the Type-C using either a powerbank or a power supply (both not included).

B0CYP7KNR6.title: Aqara Smart Curtain Motor E1 Rod Version 1Pack, Support HomeKit Alexa IFTTT
bullets: [Notes]An Aqara Hub is required and sold separately.(NOTE:Hubs from alternative brands are not compatible.) Requires a secured 2.4 gigahertz Wi-Fi network connection for Hub M2/ M1S/ E1/M1S Gen2 and Camera Hub G2H Pro/ G2H, and 2.4/ 5 GHz Wi-Fi for Camera Hub G3.(Wired connection via Ethernet RJ45 for Hub M2 is also supported.) Please make sure the firmware for the Aqara Hub and the Aqara Home App have been updated to the latest version.

[Compatiblility] The Aqara Curtain Motor E1 Rod Version supports most popular rods with uniform thickness and does not support rods with different thicknesses at the ends, such as telescopic or extendable rods. The package includes a "grommet kit". The supported diameter range for rod is 0.99 - 1.25 inches.) Please consult the images and A+ content for comprehensive installation instructions.

[Automate Your Existing Curtain and Proximity]Effortlessly install the Curtain Motor E1 onto your current curtain track or rod without requiring extra tools. It seamlessly integrates behind the curtain without altering your decor. Besides, for a sturdy connection, ensure that the Aqara Curtain Motor E1 is within 400 inches of the Aqara Zigbee hub, and the hub is within the same range from the Wi-Fi router. Additionally, make sure the hub and the router are on the same local area network (LAN).

【Smart Home Automations】The Curtain Motor E1 offers automated control of your current curtains, allowing adjustments based on weather, time, lighting conditions, or other triggered Aqara devices. Customize a sleep-wake routine to align with your personal schedule using the timer feature. Automations via HomeKit, Alexa and IFTTT are supported.(Note: Please connect the Aqara Curtain Motor E1 to Aqara hub before connecting to Apple HomeKit or enabling skills in Alexa.

【Long Battery Life】Equipped with a substantial 6000 mAh rechargeable battery, offering up to a year of usage without needing a recharge. (The calculated battery life refers to opening and closing a curtain on a 5 ft track (i.e., 2 curtain drivers per window) once a day, and it also depends on friction, curtain weight and type.) Moreover, the device can be charged via the Type-A to Type-C cable using either a powerbank or a power supply (both not included).

B0DS6XY9H4.title: Smart Automatic Curtain Opener and Closer, Zigbee Curtain Robot with App, Voice, Remote Control for U/T Rails Compatible with Alexa, Google Home, Tuya, Smart Life APP
bullets: [Note] It hates the adjustable curtain rod where the diameter changes. Support zigbee2MQTT and IFTTT. Does not work with Hubitat. 3 aa batteries are required for power supply, but the product does not include batteries. Zigbee version needs to be paired with zigbee gateway for remote control, voice control and other smart device links. The calibration process requires repeated adjustments, be sure to confirm you have the patience for this before purchasing.

[Universal, Easy to Match] Ready to hang, supporting mainstream tracks such as U-bar and I-bar. If you need to use it with Roman rod, you may need to use it with our Roman rod accessories (this product does not include this accessories), and you need to buy it separately.

[One-way/Two-way Curtain Solution] According to different requirements, we provide one-way and two-way curtain solutions. For one-way curtains, only one curtain robot is needed to realize intelligent control, while for two-way curtains, it is recommended to buy two curtain robots to achieve the effect of two-way opening and closing.

[Curtain Running Direction Can Be Changed] This intelligent curtain motor supports left and right installation, and can easily change direction through the app, ensuring seamless installation and operation regardless of your settings

[Manual Start] Gently pull, automatically open and close, even if there is no electricity, you can gently pull the curtain to a distance of more than 10cm, and it will automatically run and complete the opening and closing action.

[Inductive Resistance and Stop Function] If you encounter any resistance when opening or closing the curtain (such as old people and children blocking the movement of the curtain), the curtain will stop automatically to avoid any disaster.

[Intelligent Linkage] You can easily define the lifestyle you want and create an integrated smart home that is seamlessly integrated with the smart home ecosystem. For example, connect this intelligent curtain motor to other intelligent devices such as door locks, and automatically open the curtains when you enter the door.

[App/ Voice Control] You can control various operations through the mobile App, freely and accurately design the opening and closing ratio, and you can also set the scene through the gateway to intelligently link with other smart devices. Enable voice control through Google Assistant and Alexa. You can operate the curtains by simple voice commands.
